entries.name: Black Pullet Talisman
entries.content: A Black Pullet talisman is a defensive shield, most likely made of paper. The talisman is a small rectangle of white paper, slightly longer than a standard playing card. Drawn on it is a round black polygon symbol and text that appears to read Guarderisman . To use the amulet, one must hold it between the middle, ring, and index fingers and recite the following: "Senapos, Terfita, Estamos, Perfiter, Notarin... Parantes, Histanos..." Students Jun and Maki use a Black Pullet talisman to defend themselves and their friend and club member Kaori Saeki from Reika Kitami , the evil school nurse who invades the apartment where they practice their occult magic. Their charms are quickly rendered useless by the witch's powerful magic, and they both explode in a purple flame, causing Jun and Maki to throw them to the ground before they are able to finish the incantation.

entries.name: Bible Black
entries.content: Bible Black he large tome has sturdy black leather trimmings and is filled with B5-size yellowed and stained pages made of parchment. Depicted on the moldy and worn cover is a white hexagram symbol (Star of David) crossed by a sword. A metal chain with the same symbol is wrapped around the thick cover to hold it shut. There is a strange unidentified black ink drawing on the flyleaf. Inside the book are multiple drawings of geometric talisman shapes and several more bizarre illustrations, like acts of copulation and monstrous drawings of animals and humans. The text is handwritten in several different languages, mostly Latin and French, but also Hebrew, Greek and Gaelic. There are numerous religious quotes and passages from the Christian Gospel. The book's table of contents lists, among others; All Spells, Summoning Demons and Raising the Dead. Not the entire book is handwritten, as several pages with modern text are seen. The book also contains printed spreadsheets, though these could possible have been added later by different authors of the book. spells in Bible Black.

entries.content:
-Curse of Boiling Blood: Your target becomes aroused, but he will never have an orgasm, unless you want him to, you must draw a pentagram on an erogenous zone of your target, while reciting the incantation: Bincula cupiditatis alligant te.

-Domination Spell: A spell where a shining 6-pointed star appears in the palm of the user's hand, and after that, if he passes the will test, he can influence the target's mind to stay on his side.

-Spell Implantation: You can infuse an object with your own spells (this allows you to create magical weapons, etc.), to do this, you must place the object on top of the ritual altar with the magic circle and recite the incantation of the spell you want to imbue, while the cult members around it must recite the incantation in Latin: benedicere, imbuere, protegee.

-Resurrect the Dead: A ritual where, by sacrificing a living being in a magic circle, it is possible to resurrect someone, however it is an extremely difficult spell and requires an incredible amount of energy, the chance of success is greater during Walpurgis Night. First, one must draw a magic circle and place the corpse in its center, then sacrifice another living being and spill its blood in the circle, and recite the following incantation in Latin: e somno suscita, spiraculum vitae ad carnem tuam redeat, a pulvere, ad quem rediisti, et terram iterum ambules.

-Implantation/Possession: You can imbue an entity (usually a demon) into someone's body to influence their mind and grant them additional abilities. (can be an Imp, a spirit, or something else), to do this, one must first summon the being that wants to do this and convince it to do so, this usually requires some preparation and ritual, although, a skilled user can do it without preparations.

-Stun Spell: Takes the form of a mystical magical orb or laser that stuns the target, making them faint or become disoriented depending on their willpower. In its most advanced form, it takes the form of a purple mist that drains energy.

-Torture Spell: Unless the target is protected with powerful white magic, when cast, this spell swells the veins of its enemy, causing great pain and suffering to them.

-Memory Erasing Spell: A spell that can erase the target's recent memories, making them forget about magic and supernatural things.

-Magic Blast: Involves stabbing one's hand and firing a magical blast from the wound, causing 1D20+intelligence bonus damage.

-Levitation: A spell that allows your target to levitate.

-Lightning: A spell that makes lightning fall from the sky.

-Penis Growth: A spell that makes the target grow a penis.

-Magic Blast: A spell that releases an explosive mystical orb, not usually lethal, but can cause some damage.

-Telekiesis: A spell that allows you to move beings and objects with your mind, this can range from undoing restrictions to pushing your enemies away with magic and suffocating them with your mind.

-Healing Spells: Spells capable of healing injuries, even serious ones.

-Curse of Misfortune: A spell capable of cursing someone with bad luck, if you roll a D100 + intelligence modifier to find out how many days it will last (critical will make it eternal, until someone exorcises it), this causes the cursed to have -5 on all their tests.

-Open Portals: A spell that can open portals between dimensions, opening a portal to hell or to Earth, or to other Planets.

-Disguise: A shape-shifting spell, where you can transform yourself or other humanoid beings into humans, and thus hide supernatural characteristics from the public eye, however, magic users skilled in seeing through magical alterations, can see the real form of the beings (this is not an illusion, it is a real shape-shifting).

-Arousal Charm: This arousal charm involves drawing a talisman inside the groin area of ​​a piece of clothing. It is shaped like a triangle formed by lines and names of gods. Around the circle, a passage from Genesis 1:28 is written in Latin that reads: "And God blessed them, and God said to them, 'Be fruitful and multiply, and replenish the earth and subdue it.'" After someone puts on the clothes, they become extremely excited, overriding natural inhibitions.

-The Pentagram of Power: This spell temporarily empowers the user, giving them superhuman strength in one hand. It involves drawing a pentagram on the palm of the hand while reciting the following prayer: "The Lord is on my side, and in the day of his great wrath he will strike down all kings.".

-Wrapped Stone: A wrapped stone is a magical trinket and one of the simplest spells found in the Black Bible grimoire that causes a woman to "dance naked," that is, expose herself obscenely in public. Its effects usually cause the woman to become extremely aroused, to the point of stripping naked and masturbating in front of others, nullifying her natural inhibitions and sanity. The initial of the woman's name is written in her own blood on a piece of unused parchment (or paper). The parchment should then be wrapped around a stone and placed on top of the Black Bible or the manuscript used for mass. The Latin incantation must then be recited aloud: "Dimitte inhibitiones et patere vera colores" Then the wrapped stone is buried under a doorway through which the woman will pass. As soon as she does so, she will suddenly begin to feel the effects within a few hours. They lead to uncontrollable excitement, sweating, heavy breathing, and unfocused gait and gaze. Then, as if possessed or sleepwalking, the victim is forced to strip naked, masturbate, and climax quite explicitly before passing out from exhaustion. After this, the effects of the spell seemingly wear off.

-Paper Doll Love Curse: A paper doll or paper charm is a paper doll figure imbued with magical properties that can force someone to fall instantly in love with another person. Its effects often result in a mad obsession, overriding the target's natural inhibitions and sanity. First, the user writes the target's initial on the paper doll in their blood and then uses a magical incantation from the book: "I command you in secret, to answer the demands of my sovereign, that your spirit may enter this doll. passio, amor, forma, libido, Aphrodite, Ishtar, Freya, Eros, Maia" Then, the object is hidden somewhere near the target. When found, he or she will be affected as soon as they locate the sender. This will cause an intense love and sexual desire in him or her that seems to gradually become more maddened, to the point of desperation for more attention. The charm seemingly overrides the person's reason and inhibitions, making every concern secondary to gaining the sender's attention. The spell's effects can be countered by a magic user reciting the following to the affected target: "Hainrou ira sabesu erimidaresi. Deriea adoro. Yehoba iteyora madou dousi.".

-Conversion ritual: A ritual where a human or sinner is transformed into a demon. This ritual requires the sacrifice of 3 sinners, and after that, the energy of their souls is absorbed by the central piece of the ritual, which will then transform into a demon. What kind of demon depends on personality and luck.

-Monstrous conversion ritual: A ritual where a human is transformed into a monster. This ritual requires the sacrifice of 3 animals that refer to the monster you want to transform, spilling their blood in the magic circle of the ritual. After that, the victim must be placed on the altar above the magic circle, and the main user must have sexual relations with that person, while other members gather around the circle and recite this incantation: Sit potestas mundi in carne tua, renata in nova forma fortis What kind of monster girl the victim will transform into depends on the personality, luck, power of the performer and what was used as a sacrifice.

-Greater Demon Summoning Ritual (one of the 72 pillars): This can normally only be done during Walpurgis Night, however, a powerful user, or one who has authority in hell, is able to do this ritual, only on a full moon night. First, it is necessary to have an altar in the magic circle of the Orkus gate, and a "virgin sacrifice". First, the "sacrifice" must be placed on the altar over the circle, and the sigil of one of the 72 pillars must be drawn on her belly with a mixture of blood and semen gathered in the sacred cup, then the leader must stab the victim's belly with a magic ritual blade, this will not kill or hurt her, but it will make her mana run as if it were blood. The virgin mana will energize the circle. While this is done, the other members of the should gather around and recite the following incantation in Latin: "intrate per angustam portam quia lata porta et spatiosa via quae ducit ad interitum et multi qui ingrediuntur per eam angusta enim porta et angusta est via quae ducit ad vitam et pauci sunt qui inveniunt eam. potestatem habes faciendi quicquid vis." After this, the magic circle will transform into a portal that summons the invoked pillar to offer its services.

-Demon Lord Ritual ({{user}} was born from this ritual): A complex, long and complicated ritual, first using the sacred cup, one must collect the semen of virgin men from the lineages of Solomon, Gilgamesh, Siegfried, Arthur, Perseus, Maui and Tezcatlipoca, after that, it must be mixed with the blood of a witch and a priestess. After having the mixture ready in the cup, one must find the woman in red, who represents the female sexual impulse and the liberated woman. She was prophesied to give birth to an omnipotent being. The woman in red is a woman descended from Lilith with a sterile uterus, after finding her and making her drink the mixture of her own free will. After that, one must take her to an altar with a magic circle during the night of Walpurgis, and then, she must have vaginal intercourse with the man she loves on top of the altar, while the members of the cult watch around and pray the whole time in Latin. After sexual intercourse, the sterile woman will become pregnant and this child will be 'the one who will rule the world'.

-Ritual of Opening the Gates: This is the most complex ritual, it opens a permanent portal between Earth and Hell, making the two worlds become one. This ritual requires that the demon lord be born, and has reached the exact age of 18, no more, no less. During Walpurgis Night, the members of the ritual above the circle of the gate of Orkus must use the holy cup to collect the blood of Lilith and the semen of the demon lord. After mixing these two in the cup, the tip of the spear of Longinus must be dipped into it. The cup must then be placed on the altar in the center of the circle, and all members must recite the incantation continuously: "aperi, solvo, veni, secula uniant et in cineres renascentis nova saecla perennis sit." This will make the spear absorb the mixture from the cup and float out of it glowing red like a small scarlet star. After that, the members of the cult must have sexual relations with each other around it, while the woman in red (the lord's mother) has sexual relations with her son (the lord) on the altar in the center of the circle. The sexual energy released will be absorbed by the tip of the spear. After having absorbed enough energy, the spear will begin to descend and merge with the ground, being absorbed by the center of the magic circle. After that, the place will be taken over by a dark energy and strange tentacles, which will be absorbed by the lord, awakening his true power in the mortal world. Finally, a gigantic ray will come out of the center of the magic circle and rise to the sky, opening an interdimensional crack in the center of the sky, which will cause the two worlds to gradually merge, as the lord's powers grow.
